ko.title: 43.8%와 세 석 차이: 작센안할트주에서 거둔 AfD의 역사적 약진의 내막

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## 독일 극우 세력의 기록적인 밤

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: 독일의 정치 지도가 이번 주 작센안할트주 선거에서 대안민주당(AfD)이 역대 최고 득표율인 43.8%를 기록하면서 급격히 흔들렸습니다.

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: 이 득표율은 그동안 동독 지역에서 압도적인 우위를 점해온 프리드리히 메르츠 총리의 기독민주연합(CDU)이 얻은 득표율의 두 배가 넘는 수치입니다.

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: 이번 결과가 AfD에게 주 의회에 대한 완전한 통제권을 넘겨주는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: 당 전략가들은 AfD가 마그데부르크 주 의회에서 단독 집권에 필요한 과반에서 세 석이 부족하다고 분석했습니다.

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: 그러나 군소 민족주의 성향의 동맹 세력과 손을 잡을 경우, 이 당은 나치 정권 몰락 이전 시대 이후 그 어느 때보다 독일 주 정부 권력에 가까이 다가서게 되었으며, 이는 전국 및 그 외 지역의 정치인과 평론가들의 이목을 집중시킨 이정표가 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## 수치로 본 선거 결과

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: 작센안할트주는 과거 동독 지역에서 AfD의 영향력을 가늠하는 풍향계로 여겨져 왔으며, 이 지역에서 AfD는 꾸준히 전국 평균을 훨씬 웃도는 지지율을 기록해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: 일요일의 선거 결과는 이러한 추세를 극적으로 연장시켰습니다.

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: 수년간 주 정부를 이끌어온 CDU의 지지율은 유권자의 약 5분의 1 수준으로 떨어졌으며, 군소 중도 및 좌파 정당들이 남은 표를 나누어 가졌으나 그중 어떤 정당도 AfD의 선두를 위협하지 못했습니다.

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: 투표율은 지난 주 선거보다 높았던 것으로 보고되었으며, 이는 전통적인 집권 정당에 대한 무관심을 반영하기보다는 여러 진영의 유권자들이 적극적으로 투표에 참여했음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## AfD가 과반에 미달한 이유

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: 역사적인 득표율에도 불구하고, 독일의 비례대표제와 지역구 의석 배분 방식으로 인해 AfD는 단독으로 정부를 수립하는 데 필요한 문턱을 아쉽게 넘지 못했습니다.

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: 안정적인 과반을 달성하기 위해 당은 주 선거 문턱을 넘은 성향이 유사한 소규모 정당과 공식적으로 연합해야 하는 상황인데, 이는 지금까지 전후 독일 주 정치에서 거의 이론상으로만 존재했던 시나리오입니다.

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: 그러한 연정이 실제로 성사될 수 있을지는 여전히 불투명합니다.

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: 독일의 주 헌법과 연정 구성 관행에는 여러 견제 장치가 포함되어 있으며, 주류 정당들은 지금까지 국가 차원 및 대부분의 주 차원에서 AfD와 함께 통치하기를 거부하는 이른바 "방화벽(firewall)" 정책을 유지해 왔습니다.

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 전국적인 반응과 향후 전망

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: 이번 결과는 이민, 경제적 불안, 지역 정체성을 다루는 전통적인 선거 운동을 통해 동독 지역에서 AfD의 부상을 저지하는 데 고전해 온 베를린의 메르츠 총리와 CDU 지도부에 즉각적인 압박으로 작용하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 작센안할트주의 결과가 향후 주 및 연방 선거를 앞두고 AfD와의 협력을 단호히 거부할 것인지, 아니면 전략을 재고할 것인지를 두고 CDU 내부의 논쟁을 더욱 격화시킬 것으로 보고 있습니다.

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: 사회민주당(SPD)과 녹색당을 포함한 다른 독일 정당들은 AfD의 강령이 독일의 헌정 질서와 양립할 수 없다고 주장하며 방화벽 접근 방식에 대한 의지를 거듭 확인했습니다.

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: 독일 연방헌법옹호청(국내 정보기관)은 이전에 여러 주에서 당의 일부 요소를 극단주의로 규정한 바 있으며, AfD는 이에 대해 이의를 제기하며 법적 대응에 나섰습니다.

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: 현재 작센안할트주는 불확실한 연정 협상 국면에 접어들었습니다.

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: AfD가 득표율을 곧바로 집권 과반으로 연결하지 못하더라도, CDU 득표율의 두 배를 넘고 당 역사상 최고치를 기록한 일요일 선거 결과의 규모는 독일이 향후 전국 선거를 바라보는 시점에서 국경을 넘어 큰 파장을 일으킬 주 정치 지형의 지속적인 변화를 예고하고 있습니다.

zh.title: 43.8% 与三席之差：深入了解德国选择党（AfD）在萨克森-安哈尔特州的里程碑式突破

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## 德国极右翼创纪录的一夜

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: 本周，德国政治版图发生剧烈变动，德国选择党（AfD）在萨克森-安哈尔特州的州选举中获得了有史以来最强劲的成绩，赢得了 43.8% 的选票。

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: 这一得票率是长期以来在该东部州占据主导地位的弗里德里希·默茨（Friedrich Merz）总理所属的基督教民主联盟（CDU）得票率的两倍多。

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: 这一结果并未让 AfD 直接获得州议会的控制权。

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: 党内策略师计算得出，AfD 距离在马格德堡州议会单独执政所需的多数席位还差三个席位。

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: 但加上一个较小的民族主义盟友，该党目前在德国各州中距离权力中心的位置比纳粹政权倒台前的任何时候都要近——这一里程碑事件引起了全国乃至全球政治家和评论员的关注。

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## 票数分析

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: 萨克森-安哈尔特州一直被视为 AfD 在前东德地区实力的风向标，该党在那里的民调支持率一直远高于其全国平均水平。

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: 周日的结果戏剧性地延续了这一趋势。

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: 多年来一直领导州政府的基民盟（CDU），其支持率跌至选民总数的五分之一左右，而较小的中间派和左翼政党则瓜分了剩余的选票，没有一个政党能对 AfD 的领先地位构成威胁。

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: 据报道，此次投票率高于上届州选举，这表明此次竞选动员了多方选民，而非反映了对传统执政党的冷漠。

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## 为什么 AfD 未能获得多数席位

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: 尽管获得了历史性的选票份额，但德国的比例代表制和直接选举产生的选区席位分配，使得 AfD 距离单独组建政府所需的门槛仅差一步之遥。

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: 为了达到有效多数，该党需要与一个同样跨越了州选举门槛、志同道合的小党正式结盟——这种情况在战后德国州政治中此前大多仅存在于理论层面。

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: 这种联盟是否真的能够形成仍不确定。

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: 德国各州宪法和组阁惯例包含多种制衡机制，主流政党迄今为止一直坚持所谓的“防火墙”政策，即拒绝在国家层面，以及在大多数情况下在州层面与 AfD 共同执政。

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 全国反应及后续影响

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: 这一结果给柏林的默茨总理和基民盟领导层带来了直接压力，他们一直试图通过在移民、经济焦虑和地区认同等问题上的传统竞选活动来遏制 AfD 在东部各州的崛起。

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: 分析人士指出，萨克森-安哈尔特州的结果可能会加剧基民盟内部的辩论：是继续坚持拒绝与 AfD 合作的立场，还是在未来的州和联邦选举前重新考虑其战略。

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: 包括社会民主党和绿党在内的其他德国政党重申了他们对“防火墙”策略的承诺，认为 AfD 的纲领仍然与德国的宪法秩序不相容。

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: 德国国内情报机构此前已将该党在多个州的成员归类为极端分子，AfD 对此定性表示异议，并已在法庭上提出质疑。

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: 目前，萨克森-安哈尔特州进入了不确定的组阁谈判期。

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: 即使 AfD 不能立即将其选票份额转化为执政多数，周日结果的规模——是基民盟得票数的两倍多，也是该党的历史最高点——标志着该州政治格局发生了持久的转变，随着德国展望未来的全国大选，这种转变很可能会产生超越其边界的影响。

hi.title: 43.8% और तीन सीटों की कमी: सैक्सनी-एनहाल्ट में AfD की ऐतिहासिक सफलता के भीतर

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## जर्मनी के धुर दक्षिणपंथ के लिए एक रिकॉर्ड रात

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: जर्मनी का राजनीतिक मानचित्र इस सप्ताह तेजी से बदला, जब 'अल्टरनेटिव फॉर जर्मनी' (AfD) ने सैक्सनी-एनहाल्ट में राज्य चुनाव में अब तक का अपना सबसे मजबूत परिणाम दर्ज किया और 43.8% वोट हासिल किए।

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: यह आंकड़ा चांसलर फ्रेडरिक मर्ज़ की 'क्रिश्चियन डेमोक्रेटिक यूनियन' (CDU) द्वारा प्राप्त वोट शेयर से दोगुने से भी अधिक था, जो लंबे समय से पूर्वी जर्मन राज्य में प्रमुख शक्ति रही है।

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: यह परिणाम AfD को राज्य विधायिका पर पूर्ण नियंत्रण नहीं देता है।

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: पार्टी रणनीतिकारों ने गणना की कि AfD मैगडेबर्ग राज्य संसद में अकेले शासन करने के लिए आवश्यक बहुमत से तीन सीटें पीछे रह गई।

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: लेकिन एक छोटे राष्ट्रवादी सहयोगी के साथ मिलकर, पार्टी अब नाजी शासन के पतन से पहले के वर्षों के बाद से किसी भी समय की तुलना में जर्मन राज्य में सत्ता के करीब है — एक ऐसा मील का पत्थर जिसने देश भर और उससे बाहर के राजनेताओं और टिप्पणीकारों का ध्यान आकर्षित किया है।

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## आंकड़ों का विश्लेषण कैसे रहा

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: सैक्सनी-एनहाल्ट को पूर्व पूर्वी जर्मनी में AfD की ताकत के लिए एक संकेतक माना जाता रहा है, जहां पार्टी ने लगातार अपने राष्ट्रीय औसत से काफी बेहतर प्रदर्शन किया है।

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: रविवार के परिणाम ने उस प्रवृत्ति को नाटकीय रूप से बढ़ा दिया।

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: CDU, जिसने वर्षों से राज्य सरकार का नेतृत्व किया है, का समर्थन घटकर मतदाताओं के लगभग पांचवें हिस्से तक रह गया, जबकि छोटे मध्यमार्गी और वामपंथी दलों ने शेष वोट को कई दलों में विभाजित कर दिया, जिनमें से कोई भी AfD की बढ़त को चुनौती देने के करीब नहीं आया।

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: मतदान पिछले राज्य चुनाव की तुलना में अधिक बताया गया, जो यह दर्शाता है कि चुनाव ने पारंपरिक शासी दलों के प्रति उदासीनता को दर्शाने के बजाय कई पक्षों के मतदाताओं को लामबंद किया।

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## AfD बहुमत से पीछे क्यों रह गई

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: ऐतिहासिक वोट शेयर के बावजूद, जर्मनी की आनुपातिक प्रतिनिधित्व प्रणाली और सीधे निर्वाचित निर्वाचन क्षेत्र की सीटों के वितरण ने AfD को अपने दम पर सरकार बनाने के लिए आवश्यक सीमा से थोड़ा पीछे छोड़ दिया।

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: कार्यकारी बहुमत तक पहुंचने के लिए, पार्टी को औपचारिक रूप से एक छोटी समान विचारधारा वाली पार्टी के साथ साझेदारी करने की आवश्यकता होगी जिसने राज्य की चुनावी सीमा को भी पार किया हो — एक ऐसा परिदृश्य जो अब तक, युद्ध के बाद की जर्मन राज्य राजनीति में काफी हद तक सैद्धांतिक था।

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: क्या ऐसी गठबंधन वास्तव में बनाई जा सकती है, यह अनिश्चित बना हुआ है।

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: जर्मन राज्य के संविधान और गठबंधन-निर्माण सम्मेलनों में कई जांच शामिल हैं, और मुख्यधारा की पार्टियों ने अब तक राष्ट्रीय और अधिकांश मामलों में राज्य स्तर पर AfD के साथ शासन करने से इनकार करने की तथाकथित "फायरवॉल" नीति बनाए रखी है।

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## राष्ट्रीय प्रतिक्रिया और आगे क्या

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: यह परिणाम बर्लिन में चांसलर मर्ज़ और CDU नेतृत्व पर तत्काल दबाव डालता है, जिन्होंने प्रवासन, आर्थिक चिंता और क्षेत्रीय पहचान पर पारंपरिक प्रचार के माध्यम से पूर्वी राज्यों में AfD के उदय को रोकने के लिए संघर्ष किया है।

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि सैक्सनी-एनहाल्ट का परिणाम CDU के भीतर इस बहस को तेज करने की संभावना है कि क्या AfD के साथ सहयोग करने से अपने दृढ़ इनकार को बनाए रखा जाए या भविष्य के राज्य और संघीय चुनावों से पहले अपनी रणनीति पर पुनर्विचार किया जाए।

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: सोशल डेमोक्रेट्स और ग्रीन्स सहित अन्य जर्मन दलों ने फायरवॉल दृष्टिकोण के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता दोहराई है, यह तर्क देते हुए कि AfD का मंच जर्मनी के संवैधानिक आदेश के साथ असंगत बना हुआ है।

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: जर्मनी की घरेलू खुफिया सेवा ने पहले कई राज्यों में पार्टी के तत्वों को चरमपंथी के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया है, एक ऐसा पदनाम जिसे AfD विवादित मानती है और उसने अदालत में चुनौती दी है।

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, सैक्सनी-एनहाल्ट अनिश्चित गठबंधन वार्ता की अवधि में प्रवेश कर रहा है।

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: भले ही AfD अपने वोट शेयर को तुरंत शासी बहुमत में न बदल सके, रविवार के परिणाम का पैमाना — CDU के आंकड़े से दोगुने से अधिक और पार्टी के लिए एक ऐतिहासिक उच्च स्तर — राज्य के राजनीतिक परिदृश्य में एक स्थायी बदलाव का संकेत देता है, जो जर्मनी के भविष्य के राष्ट्रीय चुनावों की ओर देखते हुए अपनी सीमाओं से परे भी गूंजने की संभावना है।

es.title: 43.8% y a tres escaños de la mayoría: dentro del histórico avance de la AfD en Sajonia-Anhalt

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## Una noche récord para la extrema derecha alemana

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: El mapa político de Alemania dio un giro brusco esta semana después de que Alternativa para Alemania (AfD) obtuviera el mejor resultado de su historia en unas elecciones estatales, logrando el 43.8% de los votos en Sajonia-Anhalt.

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: La cifra duplicó con creces la proporción obtenida por la Unión Demócrata Cristiana (CDU) del canciller Friedrich Merz, que durante mucho tiempo ha sido la fuerza dominante en este estado del este de Alemania.

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: El resultado no otorga a la AfD el control absoluto de la legislatura estatal.

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: Los estrategas del partido calcularon que a la AfD le faltaron tres escaños para alcanzar la mayoría necesaria para gobernar en solitario en el parlamento estatal de Magdeburgo.

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, en combinación con un aliado nacionalista más pequeño, el partido se encuentra ahora más cerca del poder en un estado alemán que en cualquier otro momento desde los años anteriores a la caída del régimen nazi, un hito que ha llamado la atención de políticos y analistas en todo el país y fuera de él.

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## Cómo se desglosaron las cifras

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: Sajonia-Anhalt ha sido considerada un barómetro de la fuerza de la AfD en la antigua Alemania Oriental, donde el partido ha obtenido sistemáticamente resultados muy por encima de su media nacional.

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: El resultado del domingo amplió drásticamente esa tendencia.

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: La CDU, que ha liderado el gobierno estatal durante años, vio caer su apoyo a aproximadamente una quinta parte del electorado, mientras que los partidos más pequeños de centro y de izquierda se repartieron el voto restante entre varias formaciones, ninguna de las cuales estuvo cerca de desafiar el liderazgo de la AfD.

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: Se informó de que la participación fue mayor que en las elecciones estatales anteriores, lo que sugiere que la contienda movilizó a los votantes de múltiples sectores en lugar de reflejar apatía hacia los partidos gobernantes tradicionales.

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## Por qué la AfD se quedó corta de la mayoría

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: A pesar de la histórica proporción de votos, el sistema de representación proporcional de Alemania y la distribución de los escaños de circunscripción elegidos directamente dejaron a la AfD justo por debajo del umbral necesario para formar gobierno por sí sola.

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: Para alcanzar una mayoría operativa, el partido necesitaría asociarse formalmente con un partido más pequeño de ideas afines que también hubiera superado el umbral electoral del estado, un escenario que, hasta ahora, había sido en gran medida teórico en la política estatal alemana de la posguerra.

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Sigue siendo incierto si realmente se puede formar una coalición de este tipo.

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: Las constituciones estatales alemanas y las convenciones para la formación de coaliciones incluyen múltiples controles, y los partidos mayoritarios han mantenido hasta ahora la llamada política de "cortafuegos" de negarse a gobernar con la AfD a nivel nacional y, en la mayoría de los casos, a nivel estatal.

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Reacción nacional y qué viene después

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: El resultado ejerce una presión inmediata sobre el canciller Merz y la dirección de la CDU en Berlín, que han luchado por frenar el ascenso de la AfD en los estados orientales mediante campañas convencionales sobre migración, ansiedad económica e identidad regional.

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: Los analistas señalan que es probable que el resultado de Sajonia-Anhalt intensifique el debate dentro de la CDU sobre si mantener su firme negativa a cooperar con la AfD o reconsiderar su estrategia de cara a las futuras contiendas estatales y federales.

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: Otros partidos alemanes, incluidos los socialdemócratas y los verdes, han reiterado su compromiso con el enfoque del cortafuegos, argumentando que el programa de la AfD sigue siendo incompatible con el orden constitucional de Alemania.

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: El servicio de inteligencia nacional de Alemania ha clasificado previamente a elementos del partido como extremistas en varios estados, una designación que la AfD disputa y ha impugnado ante los tribunales.

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: Por ahora, Sajonia-Anhalt entra en un periodo de conversaciones de coalición inciertas.

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: Incluso si la AfD no puede traducir inmediatamente su porcentaje de votos en una mayoría de gobierno, la magnitud del resultado del domingo —más del doble de la cifra de la CDU e histórico máximo para el partido— señala un cambio duradero en el panorama político del estado que probablemente repercutirá mucho más allá de sus fronteras a medida que Alemania mira hacia las futuras elecciones nacionales.

ar.title: 43.8% وثلاثة مقاعد فقط: نظرة على الاختراق التاريخي لحزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا في ولاية ساكسونيا-أنهالت

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## ليلة قياسية لليمين المتطرف في ألمانيا

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: شهدت الخريطة السياسية في ألمانيا تحولاً حاداً هذا الأسبوع بعد أن حقق حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا (AfD) أقوى نتيجة له على الإطلاق في انتخابات الولاية، حيث حصل على 43.8% من الأصوات في ولاية ساكسونيا-أنهالت.

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: كانت هذه النتيجة أكثر من ضعف الحصة التي حصل عليها الاتحاد الديمقراطي المسيحي (CDU) بزعامة المستشار فريدريش ميرتس، والذي كان لفترة طويلة القوة المهيمنة في هذه الولاية الواقعة شرق ألمانيا.

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: لا تمنح هذه النتيجة حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا سيطرة كاملة على برلمان الولاية.

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: حسب استراتيجيو الحزب أن البديل من أجل ألمانيا كان ينقصه ثلاثة مقاعد فقط لتحقيق الأغلبية اللازمة للحكم بمفرده في برلمان ولاية ماغديبورغ.

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: ولكن بالتحالف مع حليف قومي أصغر، أصبح الحزب الآن أقرب إلى السلطة في ولاية ألمانية من أي وقت مضى منذ السنوات التي سبقت سقوط النظام النازي - وهو إنجاز جذب انتباه السياسيين والمعلقين في جميع أنحاء البلاد وخارجها.

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## كيف جاءت تفاصيل الأرقام

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: لطالما اعتُبرت ولاية ساكسونيا-أنهالت مؤشراً على قوة حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا في ألمانيا الشرقية السابقة، حيث كان الحزب يحصل باستمرار على نتائج أعلى بكثير من متوسطه الوطني.

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: وقد عززت نتيجة يوم الأحد هذا الاتجاه بشكل كبير.

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: شهد الاتحاد الديمقراطي المسيحي، الذي قاد حكومة الولاية لسنوات، انخفاض دعمه إلى حوالي خُمس الناخبين، بينما تقاسمت الأحزاب الوسطية واليسارية الأصغر الأصوات المتبقية عبر عدة أحزاب، لم يقترب أي منها من تحدي صدارة حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا.

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: أُفيد بأن نسبة الإقبال كانت أعلى مما كانت عليه في انتخابات الولاية السابقة، مما يشير إلى أن المنافسة حشدت الناخبين من عدة أطراف بدلاً من أن تعكس اللامبالاة تجاه الأحزاب الحاكمة التقليدية.

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## لماذا لم يحقق حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا الأغلبية

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: على الرغم من حصة التصويت التاريخية، فإن نظام التمثيل النسبي في ألمانيا وتوزيع مقاعد الدوائر الانتخابية المباشرة جعل حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا أقل بقليل من العتبة اللازمة لتشكيل حكومة بمفرده.

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: للوصول إلى أغلبية عملية، سيحتاج الحزب إلى الشراكة رسمياً مع حزب أصغر يشاركه التوجهات وتجاوز أيضاً العتبة الانتخابية للولاية - وهو سيناريو كان، حتى الآن، نظرياً إلى حد كبير في سياسات الولايات الألمانية في فترة ما بعد الحرب.

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: لا يزال من غير المؤكد ما إذا كان يمكن تشكيل مثل هذا الائتلاف بالفعل.

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: تتضمن دساتير الولايات الألمانية واتفاقيات بناء الائتلافات ضوابط متعددة، وقد حافظت الأحزاب الرئيسية حتى الآن على سياسة ما يسمى بـ "جدار الحماية" المتمثلة في رفض الحكم مع حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا على المستوى الوطني، وفي معظم الحالات، على مستوى الولاية.

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## رد الفعل الوطني وما سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: تضع النتيجة ضغوطاً فورية على المستشار ميرتس وقيادة الاتحاد الديمقراطي المسيحي في برلين، الذين كافحوا للحد من صعود حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا في الولايات الشرقية من خلال الحملات التقليدية حول الهجرة والقلق الاقتصادي والهوية الإقليمية.

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: يشير المحللون إلى أن نتيجة ساكسونيا-أنهالت من المرجح أن تكثف النقاش داخل الاتحاد الديمقراطي المسيحي حول ما إذا كان يجب الحفاظ على رفضه القاطع للتعاون مع حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا أو إعادة النظر في استراتيجيته قبل المنافسات المستقبلية على مستوى الولاية والاتحادية.

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: وقد أكدت الأحزاب الألمانية الأخرى، بما في ذلك الحزب الديمقراطي الاجتماعي وحزب الخضر، التزامها بنهج جدار الحماية، بحجة أن برنامج حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا لا يزال غير متوافق مع النظام الدستوري الألماني.

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: وقد صنفت هيئة الاستخبارات المحلية الألمانية سابقاً عناصر من الحزب كمتطرفين في عدة ولايات، وهو تصنيف يعترض عليه حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا وقد طعن فيه أمام المحكمة.

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، تدخل ولاية ساكسونيا-أنهالت فترة من محادثات الائتلاف غير المؤكدة.

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: حتى لو لم يتمكن حزب البديل من أجل ألمانيا من ترجمة حصته في التصويت فوراً إلى أغلبية حاكمة، فإن حجم نتيجة يوم الأحد - أكثر من ضعف حصة الاتحاد الديمقراطي المسيحي وعلامة فارقة تاريخية للحزب - يشير إلى تحول دائم في المشهد السياسي للولاية من المرجح أن يتردد صداه إلى ما هو أبعد من حدودها بينما تتطلع ألمانيا نحو الانتخابات الوطنية المستقبلية.

fr.title: 43,8 % et trois sièges manquants : Au cœur de la percée historique de l'AfD en Saxe-Anhalt

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## Une nuit record pour l'extrême droite allemande

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: La carte politique de l'Allemagne a fortement basculé cette semaine après que l'Alternative pour l'Allemagne (AfD) a enregistré le meilleur résultat de son histoire lors d'une élection régionale, remportant 43,8 % des voix en Saxe-Anhalt.

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: Ce score représente plus du double de la part obtenue par l'Union chrétienne-démocrate (CDU) du chancelier Friedrich Merz, longtemps la force dominante dans cet État de l'Est allemand.

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: Ce résultat ne donne pas à l'AfD le contrôle absolu du parlement régional.

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: Les stratèges du parti ont calculé qu'il manquait trois sièges à l'AfD pour atteindre la majorité nécessaire afin de gouverner seul au parlement régional de Magdebourg.

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: Mais combiné à un allié nationaliste plus modeste, le parti se trouve désormais plus proche du pouvoir dans un État allemand qu'à tout autre moment depuis les années précédant la chute du régime nazi — un échelon historique qui a attiré l'attention des politiciens et des commentateurs dans tout le pays et au-delà.

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## Comment les chiffres se répartissent

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: La Saxe-Anhalt a été considérée comme un indicateur de la force de l'AfD dans l'ancienne Allemagne de l'Est, où le parti a constamment obtenu des résultats bien supérieurs à sa moyenne nationale.

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: Le résultat de dimanche a amplifié cette tendance de manière spectaculaire.

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: La CDU, qui dirige le gouvernement régional depuis des années, a vu son soutien chuter à environ un cinquième de l'électorat, tandis que des parties centristes et de gauche plus petites se sont partagé le reste des voix entre plusieurs formations, dont aucune n'est venue contester la tête à l'AfD.

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: Le taux de participation aurait été plus élevé que lors de l'élection régionale précédente, ce qui suggère que le scrutin a mobilisé les électeurs de tous bords plutôt que de refléter une apathie envers les partis gouvernants traditionnels.

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'AfD n'a pas atteint la majorité absolue

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: Malgré cette part de voix historique, le système de représentation proportionnelle de l'Allemagne et la répartition des sièges de circonscription directement élus ont laissé l'AfD juste en dessous du seuil nécessaire pour former un gouvernement de manière autonome.

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: Pour atteindre une majorité de travail, le parti devrait formellement s'associer à une plus petite formation aux idées similaires ayant elle aussi franchi le seuil électoral régional — un scénario qui, jusqu'à présent, était largement théorique dans la politique régionale allemande d'après-guerre.

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: La possibilité de former effectivement une telle coalition reste incertaine.

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: Les constitutions des États allemands et les conventions de formation de coalition prévoient de multiples garde-fous, et les partis traditionnels ont jusqu'à présent maintenu une politique dite de « cordon sanitaire » (ou « firewall ») refusant de gouverner avec l'AfD au niveau national et, dans la plupart des cas, au niveau régional.

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Réaction nationale et quelles suites à venir

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: Le résultat met une pression immédiate sur le chancelier Merz et la direction de la CDU à Berlin, qui ont lutté pour freiner l'ascension de l'AfD dans les États de l'Est par des campagnes conventionnelles sur la migration, l'inquiétude économique et l'identité régionale.

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: Les analystes notent que le résultat en Saxe-Anhalt va probablement intensifier le débat au sein de la CDU sur la question de savoir s'il faut maintenir son refus ferme de coopérer avec l'AfD ou reconsidérer sa stratégie à l'approche des futures échéances électorales régionales et fédérales.

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: D'autres partis allemands, notamment les social-démocrates et les Verts, ont réitéré leur engagement envers le principe du cordon sanitaire, faisant valoir que le programme de l'AfD reste incompatible avec l'ordre constitutionnel allemand.

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: Le service de renseignement intérieur allemand a précédemment classé des éléments du parti comme extrémistes dans plusieurs États, une qualification que l'AfD conteste et a attaquée en justice.

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la Saxe-Anhalt entre dans une période de négociations de coalition incertaines.

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: Même si l'AfD ne peut pas traduire immédiatement sa part de voix en une majorité gouvernementale, l'ampleur du résultat de dimanche — plus du double du score de la CDU et un sommet historique pour le parti — signale un changement durable dans le paysage politique de l'État qui est susceptible de résonner bien au-delà de ses frontières alors que l'Allemagne se tourne vers les futures élections nationales.

pt.title: 43,8% e três cadeiras a menos: por dentro do avanço histórico da AfD na Saxônia-Anhalt

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## Uma noite recorde para a extrema-direita da Alemanha

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: O mapa político da Alemanha mudou drasticamente esta semana depois que a Alternativa para a Alemanha (AfD) registrou seu resultado mais forte de todos os tempos em uma eleição estadual, conquistando 43,8% dos votos na Saxônia-Anhalt.

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: A contagem foi mais que o dobro da parcela obtida pela União Democrata-Cristã (CDU) do chanceler Friedrich Merz, há muito tempo a força dominante no estado do leste alemão.

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: O resultado não confere à AfD o controle total da legislatura estadual.

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: Os estrategistas do partido calcularam que a AfD ficou a três cadeiras de distância da maioria necessária para governar sozinha no parlamento estadual de Magdeburgo.

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: Mas, combinada com um aliado nacionalista menor, o partido agora está mais perto do poder em um estado alemão do que em qualquer outro momento desde os anos anteriores à queda do regime nazista — um marco que atraiu a atenção de políticos e comentaristas de todo o país e além.

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## Como os números se dividiram

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: A Saxônia-Anhalt tem sido considerada um termômetro para a força da AfD na antiga Alemanha Oriental, onde o partido tem consistentemente obtido resultados bem acima da sua média nacional.

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: O resultado de domingo estendeu essa tendência drasticamente.

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: A CDU, que liderou o governo estadual por anos, viu seu apoio cair para cerca de um quinto do eleitorado, enquanto partidos centristas e de esquerda menores dividiram o restante dos votos entre várias legendas, nenhuma das quais chegou perto de desafiar a liderança da AfD.

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: A participação eleitoral foi relatada como sendo maior do que na eleição estadual anterior, sugerindo que a disputa mobilizou eleitores de vários lados, em vez de refletir apatia em relação aos partidos governantes tradicionais.

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## Por que a AfD não alcançou a maioria

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: Apesar da parcela histórica de votos, o sistema de representação proporcional da Alemanha e a distribuição de cadeiras de distritos eleitorais diretamente eleitos deixaram a AfD pouco abaixo do limite necessário para formar um governo por conta própria.

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: Para alcançar uma maioria funcional, o partido precisaria formar uma parceria formal com um partido menor e com ideias semelhantes que também atingisse o limite eleitoral do estado — um cenário que, até agora, era amplamente teórico na política estadual alemã do pós-guerra.

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Se tal coalizão pode realmente ser formada, permanece incerto.

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: As constituições estaduais alemãs e as convenções de formação de coalizões incluem múltiplos freios, e os partidos tradicionais mantiveram até agora uma política de "firewall" (parede de proteção) de se recusar a governar com a AfD em nível nacional e, na maioria dos casos, em nível estadual.

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Reação nacional e o que vem a seguir

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: O resultado coloca pressão imediata sobre o chanceler Merz e a liderança da CDU em Berlim, que têm lutado para conter a ascensão da AfD nos estados do leste por meio de campanhas convencionais sobre migração, ansiedade econômica e identidade regional.

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: Analistas observam que o resultado da Saxônia-Anhalt provavelmente intensificará o debate dentro da CDU sobre manter sua recusa firme em cooperar com a AfD ou reconsiderar sua estratégia antes de futuras disputas estaduais e federais.

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: Outros partidos alemães, incluindo os Social-Democratas e os Verdes, reiteraram seu compromisso com a abordagem de "firewall", argumentando que a plataforma da AfD permanece incompatível com a ordem constitucional da Alemanha.

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: O serviço de inteligência doméstica da Alemanha classificou anteriormente elementos do partido como extremistas em vários estados, uma designação que a AfD contesta e desafiou nos tribunais.

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, a Saxônia-Anhalt entra em um período de negociações de coalizão incertas.

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: Mesmo que a AfD não consiga traduzir imediatamente sua parcela de votos em uma maioria governante, a escala do resultado de domingo — mais que o dobro da contagem da CDU e um marco histórico para o partido — sinaliza uma mudança duradoura no cenário político do estado que provavelmente repercutirá muito além de suas fronteiras à medida que a Alemanha olha para futuras eleições nacionais.

in.title: 43,8% dan Kurang Tiga Kursi: Mengintip Terobosan Bersejarah AfD di Saxony-Anhalt

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## Malam yang Mencetak Rekor bagi Sayap Kanan Jerman

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: Peta politik Jerman berubah drastis minggu ini setelah Alternative for Germany (AfD) mencatatkan hasil terkuatnya dalam pemilihan negara bagian, memenangkan 43,8% suara di Saxony-Anhalt.

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: Perolehan suara tersebut lebih dari dua kali lipat pangsa yang diraih oleh Christian Democratic Union (CDU) pimpinan Kanselir Friedrich Merz, yang telah lama menjadi kekuatan dominan di negara bagian Jerman timur tersebut.

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: Hasil ini tidak memberikan kendali penuh atas legislatif negara bagian kepada AfD.

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: Para ahli strategi partai menghitung bahwa AfD kurang tiga kursi dari mayoritas yang dibutuhkan untuk memerintah sendiri di parlemen negara bagian Magdeburg.

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: Namun, jika digabungkan dengan sekutu nasionalis yang lebih kecil, partai tersebut kini berada lebih dekat dengan kekuasaan di negara bagian Jerman dibandingkan kapan pun sejak tahun-tahun sebelum jatuhnya rezim Nazi — sebuah tonggak sejarah yang menarik perhatian para politisi dan komentator di seluruh negeri dan sekitarnya.

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Perincian Angkanya

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: Saxony-Anhalt telah dianggap sebagai indikator kekuatan AfD di bekas Jerman Timur, di mana partai tersebut secara konsisten memperoleh suara jauh di atas rata-rata nasionalnya.

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: Hasil hari Minggu memperpanjang tren tersebut secara dramatis.

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: CDU, yang telah memimpin pemerintahan negara bagian selama bertahun-tahun, melihat dukungannya turun menjadi sekitar seperlima dari jumlah pemilih, sementara partai-partai sentris dan kiri yang lebih kecil membagi sisa suara di antara beberapa partai, yang tidak satu pun mendekati perolehan suara AfD.

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: Tingkat partisipasi dilaporkan lebih tinggi daripada pemilihan negara bagian sebelumnya, yang menunjukkan bahwa kontes tersebut memobilisasi pemilih dari berbagai pihak alih-alih mencerminkan sikap apatis terhadap partai-partai penguasa tradisional.

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## Mengapa AfD Gagal Mencapai Mayoritas

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: Meskipun perolehan suaranya bersejarah, sistem perwakilan proporsional Jerman dan distribusi kursi daerah pemilihan yang dipilih langsung membuat AfD hanya kurang sedikit dari ambang batas yang diperlukan untuk membentuk pemerintahan sendiri.

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: Untuk mencapai mayoritas kerja, partai tersebut perlu bermitra secara resmi dengan partai kecil yang sepaham yang juga melewati ambang batas pemilihan negara bagian — sebuah skenario yang, sampai sekarang, sebagian besar bersifat teoretis dalam politik negara bagian Jerman pascaperang.

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Apakah koalisi semacam itu benar-benar dapat dibentuk masih belum pasti.

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: Konstitusi negara bagian Jerman dan konvensi pembentukan koalisi mencakup berbagai pemeriksaan, dan partai-partai arus utama sejauh ini mempertahankan kebijakan yang disebut "firewall" (tembok api) untuk menolak memerintah bersama AfD di tingkat nasional dan, dalam banyak kasus, di tingkat negara bagian.

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Reaksi Nasional dan Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: Hasil ini memberikan tekanan langsung pada Kanselir Merz dan pimpinan CDU di Berlin, yang telah berjuang untuk meredam kebangkitan AfD di negara-negara bagian timur melalui kampanye konvensional mengenai migrasi, kecemasan ekonomi, dan identitas regional.

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: Para analis mencatat bahwa hasil Saxony-Anhalt kemungkinan akan mengintensifkan perdebatan di dalam CDU mengenai apakah akan mempertahankan penolakan tegasnya untuk bekerja sama dengan AfD atau mempertimbangkan kembali strateginya menjelang kontes negara bagian dan federal di masa depan.

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: Partai-partai Jerman lainnya, termasuk Partai Sosial Demokrat dan Partai Hijau, telah menegaskan kembali komitmen mereka terhadap pendekatan firewall, dengan alasan bahwa platform AfD tetap tidak sesuai dengan tatanan konstitusional Jerman.

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: Dinas intelijen domestik Jerman sebelumnya telah mengklasifikasikan elemen-elemen partai tersebut sebagai ekstremis di beberapa negara bagian, sebuah sebutan yang dibantah oleh AfD dan telah ditentang di pengadilan.

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, Saxony-Anhalt memasuki periode pembicaraan koalisi yang tidak pasti.

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: Bahkan jika AfD tidak dapat segera menerjemahkan perolehan suaranya menjadi mayoritas pemerintahan, skala hasil hari Minggu — lebih dari dua kali lipat perolehan suara CDU dan rekor tertinggi bersejarah bagi partai tersebut — menandakan pergeseran yang tahan lama dalam lanskap politik negara bagian yang kemungkinan akan bergema jauh melampaui perbatasannya saat Jerman menatap pemilihan nasional di masa depan.

ja.title: 43.8%と3議席不足：ザクセン＝アンハルト州におけるAfDの歴史的躍進の内幕

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## ドイツ極右にとっての記録的な夜

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: ドイツの政治地図は今週、ドイツのための選択肢（AfD）がザクセン＝アンハルト州議会選挙で過去最高の得票率となる43.8%を獲得し、激変した。

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: この得票数は、同東部州で長年優勢を保ってきたフリードリヒ・メルツ首相率いるキリスト教民主同盟（CDU）の獲得票数の2倍以上であった。

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: この結果は、AfDに州議会の単独過分な支配権を与えるものではない。

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: 党の戦略家たちの計算によると、AfDはマクデブルク州議会で単独過半数を獲得するのに必要な議席数から3議席不足していた。

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: しかし、小規模な国家主義系の同盟勢力と合わせると、同党はナチス政権崩壊前の数年間を除けばどの時点よりもドイツの州政権の座に近づいたことになり、この画期的な出来事は国内外の政治家や論説委員の注目を集めている。

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## 数字が示す内訳

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: ザクセン＝アンハルト州は、旧東ドイツ地域におけるAfDの勢力を測る指標とみなされてきた。この地域で同党は一貫して全国平均を大きく上回る支持を得てきた。

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: 日曜日の結果はその傾向を劇的に拡大させた。

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: 長年州政府を率いてきたCDUは支持率を有権者の約5分の1に落とした一方、小規模な中道・左派政党が残りの票をいくつかの政党で分け合い、どの政党もAfDの優位を脅かすには程遠かった。

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: 投票率は前回の州議会選挙よりも高かったと報じられており、従来の与党に対する無関心というよりも、複数の陣営の有権者を動員した選挙戦であったことを示唆している。

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## なぜAfDは過半数に届かなかったのか

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: 歴史的な得票率にもかかわらず、ドイツの比例代表制と小選挙区の議席配分の仕組みにより、AfDは単独で政府を樹立するのに必要な閾値にわずかに届かなかった。

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: 安定した過半数に達するためには、州の選挙閾値をクリアした他の小規模な同質政党と正式に連立を組む必要があるが、これはこれまでの戦後ドイツの州政治においてはほぼ机上の空論であったシナリオである。

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: このような連立政権が実際に形成できるかどうかは依然として不透明である。

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: ドイツの州憲法や連立樹立の慣例には複数の牽制機能が含まれており、主流政党はこれまで、国レベルおよびほとんどの州レベルにおいてAfDとの連立を拒否するいわゆる「防火壁」政策を維持してきた。

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 全国の反応と今後の展望

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: この結果は、移民問題、経済的不安、地域アイデンティティに関する従来の選挙運動を通じて東部州におけるAfDの台頭を鈍らせることに苦戦してきた、メルツ首相およびベルリンのCDU指導部に直接的なプレッシャーを与えている。

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: アナリストらは、ザクセン＝アンハルト州の結果が、今後の州および連邦レベルの選挙を見据えてAfDとの協力を固辞し続けるべきか、それとも戦略を再検討すべきかについて、CDU党内の議論を激化させる可能性が高いと指摘している。

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: 社会民主党（SPD）や緑の党を含む他のドイツの政党は、AfDの綱領はドイツの憲法秩序と相容れないと主張し、防火壁のアプローチに対するコミットメントを改めて表明している。

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: ドイツの連邦憲法保衛庁は以前、複数の州で同党の一部を過激派と指定しており、AfDはこの指定に異議を唱え、法廷闘争を行っている。

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: 当面の間、ザクセン＝アンハルト州は先行き不透明な連立交渉の時期に突入する。

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: たとえAfDが得票率をすぐに統治過半数に結びつけられなくとも、日曜日の結果の規模（CDUの獲得票数の2倍以上であり、同党にとって歴史的な高水準）は、ドイツが将来の国政選挙を見据える中で、その国境を越えて波紋を広げる可能性が高い州の政治情勢の持続的な変化を示している。

de.title: 43,8 % und drei Sitze fehlen: Blick auf den historischen Durchbruch der AfD in Sachsen-Anhalt

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## Eine Rekordnacht für Deutschlands Rechtspopulisten

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: Deutschlands politische Landkarte hat sich diese Woche stark verschoben, nachdem die Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) mit 43,8 % der Stimmen in Sachsen-Anhalt ihr bislang stärkstes Ergebnis bei einer Landtagswahl erzielte.

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis lag mehr als doppelt so hoch wie der Anteil der Christlich Demokratischen Union (CDU) von Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz, die in dem ostdeutschen Bundesland lange die dominierende Kraft war.

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis bringt der AfD nicht die absolute Kontrolle über den Landtag ein.

segments.src: Party strategists calculated that AfD came up three seats short of the majority needed to govern alone in the Magdeburg state parliament.
segments.tr: Parteistrategen errechneten, dass der AfD drei Sitze zur Mehrheit fehlten, die für ein alleiniges Regieren im Magdeburger Landtag erforderlich wäre.

segments.src: But combined with a smaller nationalist ally, the party now sits closer to power in a German state than at any point since the years before the fall of the Nazi regime — a milestone that has drawn attention from politicians and commentators across the country and beyond.
segments.tr: Zusammen mit einem kleineren nationalistischen Verbündeten ist die Partei der Macht in einem deutschen Bundesland nun jedoch so nahe wie noch nie seit den Jahren vor dem Fall des Nazi-Regimes — ein Meilenstein, der die Aufmerksamkeit von Politikern und Kommentatoren im ganzen Land und darüber hinaus auf sich gezogen hat.

segments.src: ## How the Numbers Broke Down
segments.tr: ## Wie sich die Zahlen aufschlüsselten

segments.src: Saxony-Anhalt has been considered a bellwether for AfD's strength in the former East Germany, where the party has consistently polled well above its national average.
segments.tr: Sachsen-Anhalt gilt seit Langem als Gradmesser für die Stärke der AfD im ehemaligen Ostdeutschland, wo die Partei in Umfragen regelmäßig deutlich über ihrem Bundesdurchschnitt liegt.

segments.src: Sunday's result extended that trend dramatically.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis vom Sonntag setzte diesen Trend dramatisch fort.

segments.src: The CDU, which has led the state government for years, saw its support fall to roughly a fifth of the electorate, while smaller centrist and left-leaning parties split the remaining vote across several parties, none of which came close to challenging AfD's lead.
segments.tr: Die CDU, die die Landesregierung seit Jahren anführt, sah ihre Unterstützung auf etwa ein Fünftel der Wählerschaft fallen, während kleinere Parteien der Mitte und des linken Spektrums die verbleibenden Stimmen unter sich aufteilten, von denen keine auch nur annähernd die Führung der AfD gefährden konnte.

segments.src: Turnout was reported to be higher than in the previous state election, suggesting the contest mobilized voters on multiple sides rather than reflecting apathy toward the traditional governing parties.
segments.tr: Die Wahlbeteiligung war Berichten zufolge höher als bei der vorangegangenen Landtagswahl, was darauf hindeutet, dass die Wahl die Wähler auf mehreren Seiten mobilisierte, anstatt eine Politikverdrossenheit gegenüber den traditionellen Regierungsparteien widerzuspiegeln.

segments.src: ## Why AfD Fell Short of a Majority
segments.tr: ## Warum die AfD die absolute Mehrheit verfehlte

segments.src: Despite the historic vote share, Germany's proportional representation system and the distribution of directly elected constituency seats left AfD just short of the threshold needed to form a government on its own.
segments.tr: Trotz des historischen Stimmenanteils führten das deutsche Verhältniswahlrecht und die Verteilung der direkt gewählten Direktmandate dazu, dass die AfD die Schwelle zur Bildung einer Alleinregierung knapp verfehlte.

segments.src: To reach a working majority, the party would need to formally partner with a smaller like-minded party that also cleared the state's electoral threshold — a scenario that, until now, had been largely theoretical in postwar German state politics.
segments.tr: Um eine arbeitsfähige Mehrheit zu erreichen, müsste die Partei eine formelle Partnerschaft mit einer kleineren, gleichgesinnten Partei eingehen, die ebenfalls die Sperrklausel des Landes übersprungen hat — ein Szenario, das in der Nachkriegspolitik deutscher Bundesländer bis heute weitgehend theoretischer Natur war.

segments.src: Whether such a coalition can actually be formed remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Ob eine solche Koalition tatsächlich zustande kommen kann, bleibt ungewiss.

segments.src: German state constitutions and coalition-building conventions include multiple checks, and mainstream parties have so far maintained a so-called "firewall" policy of refusing to govern with AfD at the national and, in most cases, the state level.
segments.tr: Die Landesverfassungen und die Usancen der Koalitionsbildung sehen mehrere Kontrollmechanismen vor, und die etablierten Parteien haben bislang an der sogenannten „Brandmauer“-Politik festgehalten, eine Zusammenarbeit mit der AfD auf Bundes- und in den meisten Fällen auch auf Landesebene abzulehnen.

segments.src: ## National Reaction and What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Nationale Reaktionen und wie es weitergeht

segments.src: The result places immediate pressure on Chancellor Merz and the CDU leadership in Berlin, who have struggled to blunt AfD's rise in eastern states through conventional campaigning on migration, economic anxiety and regional identity.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis setzt Bundeskanzler Merz und die CDU-Führung in Berlin unmittelbar unter Druck, da sie bisher Mühe hatten, den Aufstieg der AfD in den ostdeutschen Bundesländern durch konventionellen Wahlkampf zu den Themen Migration, wirtschaftliche Sorgen und regionale Identität zu bremsen.

segments.src: Analysts note that Saxony-Anhalt's outcome is likely to intensify debate within the CDU over whether to maintain its firm refusal to cooperate with AfD or to reconsider its strategy ahead of future state and federal contests.
segments.tr: Analysten merken an, dass das Ergebnis in Sachsen-Anhalt die Debatte innerhalb der CDU darüber intensivieren dürfte, ob sie an ihrer strikten Ablehnung einer Zusammenarbeit mit der AfD festhalten oder ihre Strategie im Hinblick auf kommende Landes- und Bundestagswahlen überdenken soll.

segments.src: Other German parties, including the Social Democrats and Greens, have reiterated their commitment to the firewall approach, arguing that AfD's platform remains incompatible with Germany's constitutional order.
segments.tr: Andere deutsche Parteien, darunter die Sozialdemokraten und die Grünen, haben ihr Festhalten an der Brandmauer-Strategie bekräftigt und argumentiert, dass das Programm der AfD weiterhin unvereinbar mit der freiheitlichen demokratischen Grundordnung Deutschlands sei.

segments.src: Germany's domestic intelligence service has previously classified elements of the party as extremist in several states, a designation AfD disputes and has challenged in court.
segments.tr: Der deutsche Verfassungsschutz hat Teile der Partei in mehreren Bundesländern zuvor als gesichert rechtsextremistisch eingestuft, eine Bezeichnung, die die AfD bestreitet und gerichtlich anficht.

segments.src: For now, Saxony-Anhalt enters a period of uncertain coalition talks.
segments.tr: Vorerst tritt Sachsen-Anhalt in eine Phase ungewisser Koalitionsgespräche ein.

segments.src: Even if AfD cannot immediately translate its vote share into a governing majority, the scale of Sunday's result — more than double the CDU's tally and a historic high-water mark for the party — signals a durable shift in the state's political landscape that is likely to reverberate well beyond its borders as Germany looks toward future national elections.
segments.tr: Selbst wenn die AfD ihren Stimmenanteil nicht sofort in eine Regierungsmehrheit ummünzen kann, signalisiert das Ausmaß des Sonntagsergebnisses — mehr als das Doppelte des CDU-Ergebnisses und ein historischer Höchststand für die Partei — einen dauerhaften Wandel in der politischen Landschaft des Landes, der weit über seine Grenzen hinaus nachwirken dürfte, während Deutschland auf zukünftige Bundeswahlen blickt.

vi.title: 43,8% và thiếu ba ghế: Bên trong bước đột phá lịch sử của AfD tại Saxony-Anhalt

segments.src: ## A Record Night for Germany's Far Right
segments.tr: ## Một đêm kỷ lục cho phe cực hữu của Đức

segments.src: Germany's political map shifted sharply this week after the Alternative for Germany (AfD) posted its strongest result ever in a state election, winning 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt.
segments.tr: Bản đồ chính trị của Đức đã thay đổi mạnh mẽ trong tuần này sau khi đảng Sự lựa chọn vì nước Đức (AfD) đạt kết quả cao nhất từ trước đến nay trong một cuộc bầu cử cấp bang, giành được 43,8% số phiếu bầu tại Saxony-Anhalt.

segments.src: The tally was more than double the share earned by Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the dominant force in the eastern German state.
segments.tr: Con số này cao hơn gấp đôi tỷ lệ mà Liên minh Dân chủ Cơ đốc giáo (CDU) của Thủ tướng Friedrich Merz giành được, vốn từ lâu đã là lực lượng thống trị tại bang miền đông nước Đức này.

segments.src: The result does not hand the AfD outright control of the state legislature.
